title: My Saturday
text:
Saturday is my favorite day. I wake up late and eat a big breakfast. Then I walk to the park with my dog. We play for one hour.

In the afternoon, I visit my grandmother. She makes soup and we talk for a long time. In the evening, I go home and read a book. I feel happy and tired.

questions.text: What is Saturday for the writer?
options: The day they clean the house

questions.text: Who does the writer visit in the afternoon?
How does the writer probably feel at the end of the day?
Why does the writer probably enjoy Saturdays?
options: They can rest and spend time with people they love
They have many tests to study for

vocabulary.definition: the mother of your mother or father
the first meal of the day, eaten in the morning

paragraph_translations: El sábado es mi día favorito. Me despierto tarde y como un gran desayuno. Luego camino al parque con mi perro. Jugamos durante una hora.
Por la tarde, visito a mi abuela. Ella hace sopa y hablamos mucho tiempo. Por la noche, voy a casa y leo un libro. Me siento feliz y cansado.
